Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class ImportTeamRequest

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ImportTeamRequest
public final class ImportTeamRequest extends Object
Request used to import a Select AI Agent team definition.

The request identifies the target profile and team and accepts exactly one source: an object-storage or database-directory location, or inline team specification JSON. Inline specifications may be supplied as a JSON string or a JSON-compatible Java map. An optional object-storage credential and force flag are passed to the database package. The builder rejects blank required names and rejects requests that provide neither or both sources; the database validates the definition and its referenced resources.

Since:
1.1.0
